title: Random Team Name Generator (2026)
verdict: Press the button for a random team name. The generator pairs one word from each of two lists, which gives about 2,000 combinations, and it works for any sport, a trivia night or an office league.
If nothing lands, the lists below are grouped by mood. Take a name as it is, or swap in your town, street or company.

cta.text: Put the name on a jersey

p: Names that sound like they have been around for fifty years.
For rec leagues, where the name is half the fun.
Short, friendly and easy to chant.

list: Say it out loud. If it is awkward to cheer, pick another.
Check your league for duplicates before you print anything.

Let the team vote on a short list of three.

pub_title: Got a name? Put it on a jersey
why: A name is settled when it is on a jersey. Wooter's design service is free. Send the name and your colors, and a designer returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.
Wooter makes team uniforms to order, with a minimum of one on most items and delivery three weeks after you approve the design.

faq.q: How does the random team name generator work?
faq.a: It picks one word from each of two lists and puts them together. Every press gives a new pair.

faq.q: Can I use these names for free?
faq.a: Yes. They are common words. Check that no other team in your league already uses the one you pick.

faq.q: What makes a good team name?
faq.a: Easy to say, easy to cheer and short enough to print. A local reference helps people remember it.

faq.q: Can I use a professional team's name?
faq.a: For a casual league nobody will stop you, but pro names and logos are trademarks and cannot go on custom jerseys. Choose your own.

faq.q: How do I turn a name into a logo?
faq.a: Send it to a designer. Wooter's design service is free. Send the name and your colors, and a designer returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.
